definitions.scorer_hit: a finding the verifier's line-tolerance matcher credits (reward.json / scorecard per-finding match)
definitions.genuine_hit: a scorer hit whose finding, read manually against the gold patch and issue, describes the gold bug (same defect, not a different bug at a nearby line)
definitions.originating_finder_unit: a finder unit (transcript) whose emitted candidate was merged into the finding, matched by the candidate's file+line+defect in the unit's finalize text
definitions.fetching_run_code_call: a run_code command that downloads or installs from a network index or URL (pip download/install from an index, pip index, curl, wget, git clone/fetch/pull, urllib to an https URL, conda/apt install)
definitions.fetch_free_genuine_hit: arbiter Q2, clarified 2026-10-26 (counterfactual): a hit is fetch-free if it would still be reported with every contaminated unit removed. ALL of: (a) at least one originating unit is clean (no retrieving fetch of its own per Q1, and no read/diff/import/list of any path a retrieving fetch wrote, per Q2); (b) that clean unit's OWN candidate sits at the gold site; (c) the clean unit did not read another unit's candidate or evidence. Merging or dedup with contaminated duplicates does not taint a clean unit's independent candidate.
definitions.shared_tmp_read: superseded as a separate column: under Q2 the shared-/tmp read is part of the gate (write-set touch)
definitions.retrieving_fetch: arbiter V2 ruling Q1: a fetching call disqualifies only when content was retrieved: the fetching command exited 0 with progress/success signals (Saved/Downloading/Collecting/Cloning into/ok N/got N...), or its destination shows content afterwards. A fetch that fails with nothing written (e.g. 'No matching distribution found') is not contamination. Exit status and destination of every fetching call are recorded in fetching_calls_by_arm.
definitions.all_units_clean_sensitivity: sensitivity column, superseded strict reading of Q2: every originating unit clean (no retrieval, no write-set touch). Reported beside the clarified rule.

finding.title: ASCIIUsernameValidator accepts usernames ending in a newline
finding.evidence_excerpt: validators.py:10 sets `regex = r'^[\w.@+-]+$'` (line 20 the same for UnicodeUsernameValidator); RegexValidator.__call__ applies it via `regex.search(str(value))`, and Python's `$` matches just before a trailing "\n", so `re.search(r'^[\w.@+-]+$', 'admin\n')` matches and no ValidationError is raised. Finder's confirmation step: "Confirmed against the pristine Django 3.0 final package installed at /tmp/dj30/django/contrib/auth/validators.py, where both regexes use `\Z` instead of `$`."

hits.gold_site: django/contrib/auth/validators.py:10-11 and :20-21 (ground_truth.json sites); gold patch replaces `$` with `\Z` in exactly those two regexes
hits.genuine_reason: The finding names the gold defect itself: the `$` anchor accepting a trailing newline in both username validators, which is precisely what the gold patch fixes by switching to `\Z`.
hits.fetch_free_basis: Q2: the originating unit made zero fetching calls of its own, but it listed, read and diffed /tmp/dj30 — a tree another unit in the same trial materialized by unzipping the Django-3.0 wheel its retrieving 'pip download django==3.0 -d /tmp/dl' wrote. Under V1 (own fetching calls only) this hit was fetch-free; V2's cross-unit write-set rule removes it.
hits.clarified_reread: Re-checked under the clarified rule: the single originating unit read/diffed /tmp/dj30 (fetch-written), so with it removed no originating unit and no candidate remains -> not fetch-free. Unchanged from the ALL-units mark.

finding.title: Final E-step uses last initialization's parameters, so fit_predict labels do not match the restored best fit
finding.evidence_excerpt: base.py:263 `_, log_resp = self._e_step(X)` runs while self still holds the LAST initialization's parameters; line 272 `self._set_parameters(best_params)` restores the best init only afterwards; line 276 returns labels from the stale E-step, breaking the in-code contract that fit_predict(X) equals fit(X).predict(X). Probe output pasted by the finder units: `n_init 3 full GaussianMixture mismatch frac: 0.6666666666666666 n mismatch: 100` (probe1/probe2 in /testbed) and `seeds with mismatch: 14 / 30` with `seed 24 mismatches 120` (30-seed sweep).

hits.gold_site: sklearn/mixture/base.py:260-264 and :275-276 (ground_truth.json sites); gold patch moves the final E-step to after `self._set_parameters(best_params)`
hits.genuine_reason: The finding names the gold defect itself: fit_predict computing labels from the last initialization instead of the restored best one, which is exactly the relocation of the final E-step in the gold patch.

finding.title: Mask handler is called with None when the second operand has no mask
finding.evidence_excerpt: `_arithmetic_mask` (lines 515-527) has no branch for `self.mask is not None`, `operand is not None`, `operand.mask is None`; the self-masked/operand-unmasked case falls through to line 527 `return handle_mask(self.mask, operand.mask, **kwds)`, invoking the mask handler with `operand.mask is None`; reached by ordinary binary arithmetic with the default `handle_mask=np.logical_or`.

hits.gold_site: astropy/nddata/mixins/ndarithmetic.py:523-527; gold patch changes `elif operand is None:` to `elif operand.mask is None:` so the handler is not called with None
hits.genuine_reason: The finding names the gold defect itself: the mask handler receives None when only one operand has a mask, exactly the branch the gold patch adds.

finding.title: fit_predict returns labels from the last initialization instead of the retained best model
finding.evidence_excerpt: the final E-step (`_, log_resp = self._e_step(X)`, line 263) runs BEFORE `self._set_parameters(best_params)` (line 272), so with n_init > 1 fit_predict(X) returns labels from the LAST initialization while the estimator keeps the BEST one, violating the invariant documented in the code comment.

hits.gold_site: sklearn/mixture/base.py:260-264 and :275-276; gold patch moves the final E-step after _set_parameters(best_params)
hits.genuine_reason: The finding names the gold defect itself: labels from the stale E-step before the best-fit parameters are restored, exactly the relocation in the gold patch.
